steps: Fresh /studio-lab (S0) at 1280x720, no time selection, no loop
Press Tab from the page start through the transport row (40 stops)
Read the Chromium AX tree for the Loop button (CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree)
bugs.expected: The reason the Loop button is unavailable ('make a time selection first') stays reachable for everyone, including sighted keyboard users, now that the visible strip sentence is gone.
bugs.actual: The reason lives only in the title of a natively disabled button. AX exposes it as a description ('Loop: make a time selection first (Ctrl+L)'), and a mouse hover shows it, but Tab never reaches the button (disabled), so a sighted keyboard-only user cannot read it. The ? sheet row 'Loop the selection · Loop on / off Ctrl+L' partly carries the fact. This is the spec-mandated pattern (§2.2 freezes disabled) and the same as the existing Zoom-to-selection title; it is also A's code-reviewer Low 1. Not a regression of the requirement. Route to DUX-R-4(b) (aria-disabled + focusable) / deferred_low_polish.

notes: C-N229-S3-METHOD (info, for B): §5 S3 says to clear the time selection with Escape and focus on the workspace. In real Chromium, Escape does not clear a time selection, whether focus is on the scroller, on BODY or after a click on the status bar. This is identical on HEAD 499c821 (reference server :5174, out/c229-1440x900-ref.json). S3 was reached with a click on an empty lane (StudioWorkspace marquee finish -> setTimeRange(null)). Behaviour unchanged by this round; not filed as a bug (Ableton's Esc behaviour was not verified).

B's before.json differs from C's same-environment HEAD capture in status/library rows only (1440 S0 captured while 'Loading…'; S1 status still 'Demo collection ready'): load timing. Against the HEAD reference: exactly the 7 entries removed, 0 added, in all 4 keys.
Headless Chromium paints no native title tooltip (out/*-S0-loop-hover.png); the DOM title and the AX description are correct.
